# collabvue-blog

Markdown source of truth for the CollabVue blog. Rendered at `collabvue.com/blog/<slug>/`
by the Next.js app via a dynamic route that reads from this repo.

**DO NOT EDIT MARKDOWN FILES DIRECTLY.** Publish through the publish worker:

```
POST https://collabvue-publish-worker.<account>.workers.dev/api/publish/
Authorization: Bearer <PUBLISH_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "title": "...",
  "contentHtml": "<p>...</p>",
  "description": "...",
  "category": "city-guides",
  "featureImage": "https://fal.run/files/...",
  "slug": "micro-influencers-in-mumbai"
}
```

The contract, status codes, gates, daily cap and error bodies are the same as
MahaBhartiLive / gta6nerd, all defined in [`idurvesh/publish-kit`](https://github.com/idurvesh/publish-kit).

## Layout

```
src/
  index.json                 # auto-maintained by publish worker on every save
  content/
    <slug>.md                # one file per article, frontmatter + HTML body
```

## Frontmatter schema

Each `<slug>.md` looks like:

```
---
title: "Micro Influencers in Mumbai — How to Find + Hire (2026 Guide)"
slug: /blog/micro-influencers-in-mumbai/
description: "..."
category: city-guides
feature_image: https://fal.run/files/...
keywords: ["micro influencers in mumbai", ...]
created_at: 2026-09-09T05:00:00.000Z
updated_at: 2026-09-09T05:00:00.000Z
published_at: 2026-09-09T05:00:00.000Z
---

<article HTML body>
```

The `body` after the closing `---` is HTML, not markdown (the
`htmlGate` rejects raw markdown). Frontmatter is regenerated by the worker on
every save — the only field the caller controls is `category` (canonicalised
by `categoryGate`).
